mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ck_shop_track_summary (id, stat_time, granularity, org_code, product_id, dim_type, dim_value, add_cart_count) SELECT REPLACE(UUID(), '-', ''), ${bucketExpr}, #{granularity}, ${orgExpr}, ${productExpr}, #{dimType}, ${dimValueExpr}, COUNT(1) FROM ck_shop_cart_event ce WHERE ce.del_flag = 0 AND ce.event_type IN ('ADD', 'INCR') AND ce.create_time >= #{start} AND ce.create_time < #{end} GROUP BY ${bucketExpr}, ${orgExpr}, ${productExpr}, ${dimValueExpr} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE add_cart_count = VALUES(add_cart_count)

INSERT INTO ck_shop_track_summary (id, stat_time, granularity, org_code, product_id, dim_type, dim_value, order_count, order_amount) SELECT REPLACE(UUID(), '-', ''), ${bucketExpr}, #{granularity}, ${orgExpr}, 'ALL', 'global', 'global', COUNT(1), COALESCE(SUM(o.pay_amount), 0) FROM ck_shop_order o WHERE o.create_time >= #{start} AND o.create_time < #{end} GROUP BY ${bucketExpr}, ${orgExpr} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE order_count = VALUES(order_count), order_amount = VALUES(order_amount)

INSERT INTO ck_shop_track_summary (id, stat_time, granularity, org_code, product_id, dim_type, dim_value, paid_count, paid_amount) SELECT REPLACE(UUID(), '-', ''), ${bucketExpr}, #{granularity}, ${orgExpr}, 'ALL', 'global', 'global', COUNT(1), COALESCE(SUM(o.paid_amount), 0) FROM ck_shop_order o WHERE o.pay_status <> 'UNPAID' AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND o.pay_time >= #{start} AND o.pay_time < #{end} GROUP BY ${bucketExpr}, ${orgExpr} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE paid_count = VALUES(paid_count), paid_amount = VALUES(paid_amount)

INSERT INTO ck_shop_track_summary (id, stat_time, granularity, org_code, product_id, dim_type, dim_value, order_count, order_amount) SELECT REPLACE(UUID(), '-', ''), ${bucketExpr}, #{granularity}, ${orgExpr}, COALESCE(NULLIF(i.product_id, ''), 'unknown'), 'product', COALESCE(NULLIF(i.product_id, ''), 'unknown'), COUNT(DISTINCT i.order_id), COALESCE(SUM(i.actual_amount), 0) FROM ck_shop_order_item i INNER JOIN ck_shop_order o ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE i.del_flag = 0 AND o.create_time >= #{start} AND o.create_time < #{end} GROUP BY ${bucketExpr}, ${orgExpr}, i.product_id ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE order_count = VALUES(order_count), order_amount = VALUES(order_amount)

INSERT INTO ck_shop_track_summary (id, stat_time, granularity, org_code, product_id, dim_type, dim_value, paid_count, paid_amount) SELECT REPLACE(UUID(), '-', ''), ${bucketExpr}, #{granularity}, ${orgExpr}, COALESCE(NULLIF(i.product_id, ''), 'unknown'), 'product', COALESCE(NULLIF(i.product_id, ''), 'unknown'), COUNT(DISTINCT i.order_id), COALESCE(SUM(i.actual_amount), 0) FROM ck_shop_order_item i INNER JOIN ck_shop_order o ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE o.pay_status <> 'UNPAID' AND i.del_flag = 0 AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND o.pay_time >= #{start} AND o.pay_time < #{end} GROUP BY ${bucketExpr}, ${orgExpr}, i.product_id ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE paid_count = VALUES(paid_count), paid_amount = VALUES(paid_amount)
